description:
## Features

### YouTube and YouTube Music
- **Settings:** The color picker remembers the last eight colors you applied, including the color you replaced. They show as swatches under the hex field, newest first; tap one to select it, then press OK. The list is shared by all color settings of the app and has a `Clear history` button.

## Bug Fixes

### YouTube and YouTube Music
- **Settings:** Typing a hex value or tapping a swatch in the color picker moves the hue slider and the color square right away. Before, they only caught up after the dialog was reopened.

## Compatibility
- YouTube: **21.39.525, 21.13.164, 20.05.46**.
- YouTube Music: **9.40.51, 9.15.51, 8.30.54**.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/compare/v1.22.1...v1.23.0)
